description: Create or update this seat's one event subscription. inputs: which arrivals (omit for all: text_in, text_out, email_in, email_out, call_answered, call_missed, voicemail, booking_created, booking_changed, booking_cancelled, staff_clocked_in, staff_not_clocked_in, job_finished, visit_unconfirmed). contact_types: only arrivals for these contact types. A field you omit keeps its current value, so {paused:true} pauses without touching the filter; pass inputs:null or contact_types:null to go back to all. paused: true stops delivery without losing the cursor, paused: false resumes. restart: true moves your position to now and clears your ack (the resync after cursor_expired, once you have re-read current state). Delivery starts at the moment you first subscribe. Repeating the same call changes nothing.
name: events_subscribe
title: Subscribe to events
